stop_conditions: Stop at the first disagreement in source minima, literal words, endpoint heights, or record depth.
Do not reuse P86-P88 for different Phase 15B statements.
Do not infer an eventual M_star bound from source<=5000000.
Keep the permanent-safe no-crossing case explicit in any full-route implication.
Enter the proof-claim emergency protocol before changing proves_collatz.
interpretation_boundary: P90 is a conditional route whose eventual H89 inequality remains open.
Finite endpoint coverage is not a pointwise ordinary-integer theorem.
A 3-adic positive-measure complement need not omit a positive ordinary integer.
Finite compression gain need not compose or grow linearly.
